extraction.Name: Alexander Whipple
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I lost it through bankruptcy. I bought cattle and had to mortgage it as security, and couldn't pay out on the cattle and I offered to turn the deed over if they would take care of my mortgage papers, but they would not do that they wanted to foreclose and get a insufficient judgment against me for the balance of the amount, so I went through bankruptcy.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I bought cattle and had to mortgage it as security, and couldn't pay out on the cattle and I offered to turn the deed over if they would take care of my mortgage papers, but they would not do that they wanted to foreclose and get a insufficient judgment against me for the balance of the amount, so I went through bankruptcy.
extraction.NOTES: Patent mailed to him at Parmelee; he signed a receipt for it. Married with six living children. States 'I believe that I would have been better off had I never received the patent.' Superintendent: A. E. McKean. Document number Ko. 1258. Questionnaire taken April 27, 1929.
